notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain 5 or more life each turn.
description:
Gain 5 or more life.
At the beginning of your end step, Betor triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
